name: qkd_d2d_static_r7s

job.purpose: Q-LINK static D2D link end qkd_d2d_static (compiler calendars, 583-bit PHY word slot link with 4x137 SRAM store, explicit recovery mode; no credits/backpressure). PHY on face N.

pinreg_r4: r4 (2026-10-15): die master is pin-registered (PR=1, tools/qwen_split/d2d_pinreg_gen.py): every functional port has one flop at its pin, placed FIRM at the pin by recipe-2 io_flop_at_pins; fixes qkd r1 EARLY_FAIL_SETUP (-434 ps, all boundary paths) and qfd r1 TT -79 / FF -32.6.

pin_regs.reason: Production PR=1 wrapper already has one register per functional port; no extra port edges.

structural_change: r7s (ELEM-GAPS/KV 10-18) = r7q (closed arg2 PD 0.6, TT +12.27 / FF +1.91) + S-QTIES QC-12 NTX=3 (004846e49: dead KV TX port-3 lane not built; ports unchanged; lockstep vs NTX=4 1040 edges 0 mismatches) + NATIVE FIX. Closed view native FAIL (R 514.8): capture 204.5 on 65 input pins (att_tx_payload 60/548, status_epoch16 5/16), launch 221.5 transport_fault[4], TT pin-flop spread 83.4 (490.3..573.7). Routed STA classification: pins ARE flop-first (PR=1); capture = inhold pad (HB2+BUFx4f ~100 ps) + 6-8 repair_timing hold BUFx2 (~110-140 ps) on the late-clock pin flops; launch/spread = one late leaf strand (clkbuf_leaf2_61 -> leaf_344, 65 ps). Fix: (1) route.io_hold_margin_ns 0.010 (boundary hold repaired to 10 ps instead of 30, as qfd_xs_tap xt12 fixed routed capture 210.8; core hold margin 30 unchanged); (2) CTS unclustered balanced H-tree (10-15 measured on this tile at gate placement: all flops 442..508 ps, vs the clustered r7q route 490..574 with a 65-ps late leaf_344 strand carrying transport_fault[4] and status_epoch16). --relative-to cannot fix it: launch+capture sum 426 > 410 at any compensation C (C=524: launch 212 / capture 214). 0 cycles.
